description: List tasks with optional filters. Use this to find tasks by status, category, asset, or search term. By default returns titles only; pass include_description: true to also get each task's full description (use this when reviewing tasks for jurisdiction or other content-level changes). Tasks come back in the dashboard's order; each has its `position` in the full task list and `waiting_on` (the unfinished task it can't start before, or null). Each task includes assigned_to (user ID) and assigned_to_name (who it is assigned to; null when unassigned). For "what's next", pass up_next: true to get exactly the dashboard's Up Next list.

estate_id.description: The estate to act on. Call list_my_estates first to get this id.

include_description.description: When true, include each task's full description in the response. Use when reviewing tasks for content changes (e.g., jurisdiction review). Default false.

limit.description: Max number of tasks to return (default 20)

search.description: Search term to match against task title or description

up_next.description: When true, ignore the other filters and return the dashboard's Up Next list: the next open tasks in the same order the user sees on their Overview page. Use this whenever the user asks what to do next.

name: get_tasks
